Name: A Larger Hilltop
Author: Draylon
Description:
My Second Mod, Yay!

A Much Larger Replacement for the Hilltop Farm, With more Open Space, but keeping the Natural Design, Including a little Berry Grove.

Warps onto the farm are changed to align with the new entrances/exits.

[size=3]Installation Notes[/size]

Installation is simple, just drop the unpacked folder into your mods folder the same as most mods, making sure you have the required mods for this to work (in this case TMXL and ITS required mod, PyTK) in there as well

Warning the First Load will take a little bit longer than the base game (because the map is larger)

If you want to Convert over a save file from the normal Hilltop Farm, Most of the base area should be compatible, but you might have to move a few things to fully port over, and its highly recommended to reset terrain features (with something like this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715[/url])

[size=3]Confirmed Compatibility[/size]

Fully Compatible With SVE. (Provided that your SVE is up to date.)

[size=3]Final Things[/size]

I would recommend making some cabins near some exits/entrances or at other locations if want to sleep in different locations. (In which case, This mod might be handy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253[/url])


 If you have any issues or run into any bugs, please let me know and I will look into it.



[size=3]I'd Like to thank Mouse from the Stardew Valley Discord teaching me how to use TMXL and helping me with the warp edits.[/size]
